scripts.build: npm run generate && node scripts/check-all.js && vite build && node scripts/generate-pages.js

scriptNotes.dev: Starts the dev server with hot reload; it also serves the review pages (/__review/) and the KB explorer (/__kb/).
scriptNotes.build: Regenerates what changed (generate), checks every gate, then builds the static site into docs/ with one page per route.
scriptNotes.generate: Runs the build's generators in one process, each only when what it reads changed: the dictionary pages, the grammar overview, word usage, relations and the Akinator pool. --fresh runs them all.
scriptNotes.preview: Serves the built site locally, to check it before it goes out.
scriptNotes.test: Runs the fast test files with bun, several at a time (under half a minute); the slow ones, which use the real data or copy the repo, wait for test:all.
scriptNotes.test:all: Runs every test file with bun, several at a time, the slow ones first.
scriptNotes.typecheck: Type-checks the whole project with tsc (the check-types gate runs the same).
scriptNotes.translator: The translator from the command line: translate a text (only the Hao-shuo-de, in seconds, through a server it keeps running; --verbose for the report, --full for the whole pipeline), run the test set and its scores, gather the gaps, and keep the list of people who may use the online page (TRANSLATOR_PLAN.md).
